```{r dash-application-health, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# CURRENT RUN
# ============================================================

current_run_id <- raw_data %>%
  distinct(run_id, sequence_num) %>%
  arrange(desc(sequence_num)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(run_id)

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION SUMMARY
# ============================================================

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

app_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(trimws(as.character(success))) %in%
      c("true", "yes", "1")
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(

    transactions = n(),

    errors = sum(
      !is_pass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    error_rate = round(
      errors /
      transactions * 100,
      2
    ),

    successful_transactions = sum(
      is_pass,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = round(
      successful_transactions /
      duration_secs,
      2
    ),

    p95 = round(
      quantile(
        elapsed,
        0.95,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      0
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# JOURNEY SLA SUMMARY
# ============================================================

app_journey_summary <- NULL

if (!is.null(rt_summary)) {

  app_journey_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(
          label,
          thread_group,
          app_name
        ),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      app_name,
      thread_group
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      journey_passed = all(passed),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(app_name) %>%
    summarise(

      total_journeys = n(),

      passed_journeys = sum(
        journey_passed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      failed_journeys = sum(
        !journey_passed,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

}

# ============================================================
# APPLICATION TPS SLA
# ============================================================

app_tps_summary <- raw_data %>%
  filter(
    run_id == current_run_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_pass = tolower(
      trimws(as.character(success))
    ) %in% c(
      "true",
      "yes",
      "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(app_name) %>%
  summarise(

    successful_transactions =
      sum(is_pass),

    duration_secs = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        max(timestamp),
        min(timestamp),
        units = "secs"
      )
    ),

    throughput = round(
      successful_transactions /
      duration_secs,
      2
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

    throughput_target =
      get_app_tps_threshold(app_name),

    throughput_pass =
      throughput >= throughput_target

  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ============================================================
# FINAL DATASET
# ============================================================

app_health <- app_summary %>%
  left_join(
    app_journey_summary,
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    app_tps_summary %>%
      select(
        app_name,
        throughput_target,
        throughput_pass
      ),
    by = "app_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    error_pass =
      error_rate <= 15,

    journey_pass =
      failed_journeys == 0

  )

# ============================================================
# STATUS + TOOLTIP
# ============================================================

metric_badge <- function(
  value,
  passed,
  suffix = ""
) {

  sprintf(
    "<span class='%s'>%s%s</span>",
    ifelse(
      passed,
      "status-pass",
      "status-fail"
    ),
    value,
    suffix
  )

}

app_health$status_html <- mapply(

  function(
    throughput_pass,
    journey_pass,
    throughput,
    throughput_target,
    failed_journeys,
    total_journeys
  ) {

    failures <- c()

    if (!throughput_pass) {

      failures <- c(
        failures,
        sprintf(
          "TPS %.2f below target %.2f",
          throughput,
          throughput_target
        )
      )

    }

    if (!journey_pass) {

      failures <- c(
        failures,
        sprintf(
          "%s of %s journeys failed",
          failed_journeys,
          total_journeys
        )
      )

    }

    tooltip <- paste(
      failures,
      collapse = "&#10;"
    )

    if (length(failures) == 0) {

      return(
        "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>"
      )

    }

    sprintf(
      "
      <span class='status-fail'>
        FAIL
      </span>
      <i class='fa fa-info-circle breach-tooltip'
         title='%s'></i>
      ",
      tooltip
    )

  },

  app_health$throughput_pass,
  app_health$journey_pass,
  app_health$throughput,
  app_health$throughput_target,
  app_health$failed_journeys,
  app_health$total_journeys,

  SIMPLIFY = TRUE

)

# ============================================================
# HTML ROWS
# ============================================================

rows_html <- paste(
  apply(
    app_health,
    1,
    function(r) {

      sprintf(
        "
        <tr>

          <td>%s</td>

          <td>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s</td>

          <td class='numeric-cell'>%s/%s</td>

        </tr>
        ",

        r["app_name"],

        r["status_html"],

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f",
            as.numeric(r["throughput"])
          ),
          as.logical(
            r["throughput_pass"]
          )
        ),

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%sms",
            round(
              as.numeric(r["p95"])
            )
          ),
          as.numeric(
            r["failed_journeys"]
          ) == 0
        ),

        metric_badge(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f",
            as.numeric(r["error_rate"])
          ),
          as.numeric(
            r["error_rate"]
          ) <= 15,
          "%"
        ),

        r["passed_journeys"],
        r["total_journeys"]

      )

    }
  ),
  collapse = ""
)

html_output <- sprintf(
'
<div class="executive-summary">

<h3 class="scorecard-header">
Application Health Summary
</h3>

<table class="scorecard-table">

<tr>
  <th>Application</th>
  <th>Status</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">TPS</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">P95</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">Errors</th>
  <th class="numeric-header">Journeys</th>
</tr>

%s

</table>

</div>
',
rows_html
)

HTML(html_output)
```
